## 3. Confirmation  
[ Swamy's Complete Manual on Establishment and Administration]  
An officer who has successfully completed the probation, as prescribed under relevant recruitment rules, will be considered for confirmation. Confirmation should be given effect from the date following the date of the prescribed period of probation or the extended period of probation, as the case may be.
